calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, take the negative ten-day log return normalized by its trailing 20-day volatility. Activate only when the cross-asset mean of trailing 20-day volatilities exceeds its trailing 120-day 90th percentile, then lag the signal one completed day to avoid look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Strong in 2024-2026 (IC 0.061020, ICIR 0.189367), negative in 2027-2029 (IC -0.015799, ICIR -0.056589), near-neutral in 2030-2032 (IC 0.001023, ICIR 0.003931), and positive in 2032-2033 (IC 0.022347, ICIR 0.082846). Sparse activation and regime dependence warrant capped ensemble exposure.
